name: CQ | 100mg Soda | Cola
description:
PEACE. LOVE. CANNABIS.™

Born and raised in Venice Beach, California, we've been perfecting the sweet spot between fun and function since 2008. We believe that normalized, legal cannabis use makes for a better world. Crafted from the highest quality ingredients, expect a refreshing infusion of real fruit and terpene-rich cannabis for a deliciously juicy buzz. We make wellness tasty, relaxing and fun. We love what we do.

A classic Mexican style cola infused with cannabis, sweetened with cane sugar and crafted from the highest quality ingredients. Caffeinated to give you that extra boost you need.
